title: Richelieu to M. de Rancé, cipher letters of July 1629, BnF Français 3829 ff. 87 and 89

steps.what: 'la', 'd'autres', 'd'elle ... elle' (tilde = doubling), 'Brassac', 'l'ambassade' placed beside clear words.
Remaining letters from further words; alphabet and homophones recovered.
Avenel 1858 found to print both letters deciphered, with his reconstructed key.
Reading agrees with Avenel word for word; nomenclature codes resolved from his footnotes.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The homophonic alphabet was rebuilt from Tomokiyo's transcription by placing cribs beside the clear words of the same letters ('la', 'd'autres', 'd'elle ... elle', 'Brassac' after 'Mr de', 'l'ambassade' after 'pour'); Avenel's 1858 decipherment (Lettres de Richelieu t. III) was found only after the reading and used to confirm it and to name ten nomenclator codes from his footnotes.
outcome.notes: Independent ciphertext-only recovery, later matched to Avenel's 1858 decipherment; Brassac's appointment to Rome in 1630 confirms.

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
